newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-VOGTS OFFERS KLINSMANN COACHING POST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VOGTS OFFERS KLINSMANN COACHING POST.

text.p: Germany coach Berti Vogts has handed Juergen Klinsmann the chance to follow in his footsteps by offering the Bayern Munich striker a coaching post with the German Soccer Federation (DFB).

The German captain confirmed in a magazine interview released on Wednesday that he had received an offer from the DFB for the period after his playing career but added it was too early to make a decision.
"After my playing career I'll take a break for a year. Then I'll see if I can live without soccer," he said in the interview with Kicker Fussball-Magazin to be published on Thursday.
If Klinsmann were to join the DFB he would be following a path beaten by Vogts himself, who moved there in 1979 after a highly successful playing career with Borussia Moenchengladbach.
He worked his way up the ranks to succeed Franz Beckenbauer as national team coch in 1992.
Vogts also has plans for Klinsmann's Bayern team mate Thomas Helmer. He hopes to give the central defender a management role at the DFB, advising young players on how to plan their careers.
"I've noticed how calmly and assertively Helmer guides the national team. He would be the ideal partner for our young players," Vogts told Sport-bild magazine.
He said he had already discussed a role for Helmer with DFB president Egidius Braun.
